Key benefits

Why businesses choose TallyPrime.

📈

Your growth partner

TallyPrime grows with you. You can manage multiple companies and currencies, and add features such as multiple godowns, multi-currency, order processing and batches as you expand.

💸

Better control over cash flow

Quick and flexible receivables and payables management helps you get paid faster and manage payment timelines, while stock and inventory tracking helps you optimise cash.

⚙️

Improved productivity

With its speed and simple screens, you can get things done quickly. Insightful reports at the tap of a key help you make confident decisions.

🧾

Better tax compliance

GST, TDS and TCS are built in, so your books stay accurate and your filing stays on time.

💬

Send invoices, payment reminders and outstanding reports to customers on WhatsApp straight from TallyPrime.

Help me decide

Got questions? We have the answers.

Is TallyPrime easy to use? Can I use it?

Yes. TallyPrime is designed for business owners as well as accountants. It keeps information in context, offers simple navigation and lets you start working within minutes.

What is the process for setting up TallyPrime? How much time does it take?

Setup is quick: download, install, then start. It usually takes just a few minutes, and our team can do it with you.

Can you help me find an accountant to operate TallyPrime?

Yes. Ask us and we will help you find a skilled, Tally-certified accountant for your needs.

Is Tally only to be used by an accountant?

No. Business owners use it to keep track of performance, and managers use it to see reports that support better decisions.

What kind of reports can I get from TallyPrime?

You get a wide range of reports covering accounting, inventory, financial management, control reports and statutory reports to help you make confident decisions.

Can I access business reports on my mobile?

Yes. TallyPrime supports real-time access to important business reports from a web browser on any device.

What are the first-time and ongoing costs of running TallyPrime?

Pricing depends on the edition and number of users, and renewals and support are extra. Tell us your setup and we will send a clear quote.

Can someone guide me on using TallyPrime?

Yes. We offer training and onsite or remote support so your team feels comfortable with the software from the start.

What business processes can I handle with TallyPrime?

TallyPrime is an integrated business management software. You can manage accounting, inventory, GST and compliance, banking, payroll and other processes.

How many users and transactions can TallyPrime support?

With multi-user editions you can have unlimited users on the same LAN environment, handling large volumes of transactions.

Is my business data safe with TallyPrime?

Data security is a core part of the product. Access can be controlled by user, and your data stays under your control on your own systems or private setup.
